decisions.reason: As a yogurt variant very close to the firm's existing capabilities and supported by an award signal, it fits the firm's knowledge base and is likely to be improved and retained.
This flavored cheese builds directly on established cheesemaking know-how and its prominence on the home page suggests enough early promise to justify keeping it.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is strongly related to the firm's core cheese competence, so management would expect to learn from initial sales and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.
Although the spicy positioning is somewhat more niche, it still relies on familiar cheese capabilities and can be adjusted through the firm's existing product knowledge.
This mild soft cheese extends the existing range in a highly related way, and the firm's absorptive capacity in dairy processing makes continued development more likely than exit.

Washed-rind soft cheese is somewhat more specialized and may face narrower demand, but it remains close enough to the firm's cheese expertise that management would probably keep it on the market for further learning.
